data: This course is a primer to plant life, covering what comprises the plant Kingdom, how to identify different plants, and how plants reproduce. The first part of the course will explore the diversity of plants from algae to angiosperms. This will include discussions of plant evolution and phylogeny, how and when the first land plants arrived, how plants are classified, and how to identify broad groups of plants including some common Families of angiosperms. We will also explore morphological, anatomical, physiological and other adaptations of plants that allow them to grow in diverse environmental conditions. The second part of the course will focus on the different reproductive strategies of various groups of plants. Some aspects unique to plant reproduction will be discussed, such as alternation of generations in lower plants, and monoecy, dioecy, pollination strategies, double fertilization and embryogenesis in higher plants.
